'''Trep Winterrs''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] hired by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Arner Figgis]] to teach him the basics of ''[[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]]'' and introduce him to other speakers of the [[Language/Legends|language]].

He took the scholar to the Black Dust Tavern so Figgis could speak and observe the language. However, the greeting that Figgis attempted to use on [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] was misspoken so the smuggler had to step in and defuse the situation before it turned violent. He made the scholar buy a drink for the bartender, and then lead him to a table to play [[Sabacc/Legends|sabaac]] with some of the locals so Figgis could study the language in use.<ref name="AJ7">{{JournalCite|7|Old Corellian: A Guide for the Curious Scholar}}</ref>
